says: In next/, a fixed test labeled `vector:` checked a general rule, that a program name outside the app's table has no window, with one hand-picked name, `fabrika/notes`, beside `fabrika/tezgah`. Fixed in the same pull request by the fix round of 2026-11-15: it is now part of law N8's property, which draws program names outside the tiles' programs (any name, a table name with more after it, a table name in other case) plus `fabrika/tezgah`, and asserts `windowFor` answers null for each.
proof: docs/direction/five-steps-for-every-check.md:71 keeps `vector:` for 'A fixed input and answer from a spec', and the test's two names come from no spec; a prefix match planted in `windowFor` (views.ts) keeps the old test green, since neither name starts with a table name, and turns the new property red on `fabrika/counterA`.
cost: The label lets a hand-picked check of a general rule pass law-shape, and a near-miss name a prefix or case bug would answer goes unchecked.
